name: Coated In Blood raises Blood Pact's effect values by 50% (#3144)
contract: Coated In Blood 707626 effect 1 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 65536) = word 2 bit 16 = Blood Pact (801955, 801964) and no other family-26 row. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS to every effect value. Tooltip: "Increases the effectiveness of Blood Pact by $s2%", where $s2 is effect 2's value, 50. Effect 0 of 707626 is aura 107 with MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) and BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, an inert no-op that the tooltip does not describe. Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Blood Pact keeps its authored effect values before the talent
Coated In Blood raises every Blood Pact effect by 50%
The inert cooldown effect changes nothing
Coated In Blood does not touch Bloodbolt
